The '''Copero Jubilee Miniprobe''' was a model of floating [[miniprobe]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] available<ref name="Reveal" /> around [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}} mentions that the [[Dantooine Incursion]] took place in 3627 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> This droid had ties to both [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] and [[Copero/Legends|Copero]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="Reveal" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> droid pet debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[December 12]], [[2017]] as a part of the year's "Life Day Bundle."<ref name="Reveal" />
